output.answer: Rivian has no parent company: Rivian Automotive, Inc. is an independent publicly traded company and the parent of its own consolidated subsidiaries. Volkswagen AG and Amazon are significant shareholders, not Rivian’s parent—Volkswagen’s subsidiary held 14.0% of Rivian’s voting power and Amazon-related holdings represented 10.8% as of September 30, 2026.
caveats: The latest filing reports significant shareholders and ownership percentages, but does not use the exact phrase “Rivian has no parent company”; the conclusion is based on Rivian’s status as the reporting public company and the filing’s description of Volkswagen and Amazon as shareholders rather than a controlling parent.

passages.quote: Rivian Automotive, Inc. (together with its consolidated subsidiaries, “Rivian” or the “Company”) was incorporated as a Delaware corporation on March 26, 2015.
Volkswagen-US Holding, Inc. ... a wholly-owned subsidiary of Volkswagen AG, beneficially owns shares of our capital stock representing 14.0% of our voting power as of September 30, 2026.

Amazon is the parent company of both Logistics and Amazon.com NV Investment Holdings LLC, which beneficially owns shares of our capital stock ... representing 10.8% of our voting power as of September 30, 2026.
